participation.context: Asked if the margin abused him, promised the letter, and did not answer the book.

participation.context: Named himself and his shop, withheld the word, and asked for the Holinshed.
participation.name: Richard Field

relations.quote: I'll not tell thee what he calls thee.

story.body: You agreed to come at ten. You promised the letter tonight. You did not promise the Holinshed.

title: Agreed to come at ten and promised the letter tonight
